title: Rosalía makes Grammy history with nine nominations for Lux
summary: She is the first woman nominated for Album of the Year with a Spanish-language album.
body:
Spain's Rosalía has received nine nominations for the 2027 Grammy Awards, second only to Raye.

Her album Lux is nominated for Album of the Year, making her the first woman to be nominated in the category with an album sung in Spanish. Her song "Berghain" is up for both Record of the Year and Song of the Year.

A big week

The nominations come days after Lux won Album of the Year at the Latin Grammys in Las Vegas on 12 November, her third win in that category.

The Grammy winners will be announced on 7 February.

Sources: Consequence, Latin Times, the Recording Academy.
